explanation: Africa is about 14 times bigger. Greenland looks huge on the common Mercator map, which stretches lands near the poles far more than lands near the Equator.

claims.text: Africa's area is about 14 times Greenland's, so the two are not roughly the same size.
The Mercator projection enlarges areas far from the Equator much more than areas near it.
On a Mercator map, Greenland looks about as big as Africa.
